_comment: Lines from the Check in game page that the owner saw match in the real game. Key -> date seen. build_data.py marks each entry verified 'in-game' and the page stops listing it. Add lines with apply_checks.py from pasted 'Copy my results'.

recipe:recipe.CapeDeerHide.text: Workbench level 2: 4 Deer Hide, 5 Bone Fragments

recipe:recipe.KnifeFlint.text: Workbench level 1: 2 Wood, 4 Flint, 2 Leather Scraps

creature:Boar.text: drops Boar Meat, Leather Scraps, Boar Trophy

creature:Deer.text: drops Deer Meat, Deer Hide, Deer Trophy

boss:Eikthyr.text: summon with 2 Deer Trophy · drops Eikthyr Trophy, Hard Antler

where:Acorn.text: Drops when you chop oak trees

where:AxeHead2.text: Found in chests in the Meadows (reported by the owner; the game files do not list the loot)

where:BeechSeeds.text: Drops when you chop beech trees

where:BirchSeeds.text: Drops when you chop birch trees

recipe:recipe.AtgeirBronze.text: Forge level 1: 10 Wood, 8 Bronze, 2 Leather Scraps

recipe:recipe.MaceBronze.text: Forge level 1: 4 Wood, 8 Bronze, 3 Leather Scraps

recipe:recipe.SpearBronze.text: Forge level 1: 5 Wood, 6 Bronze, 2 Deer Hide

recipe:recipe.ShieldBoneTower.text: Workbench level 3: 10 Wood, 10 Bone Fragments, 3 Skeleton Trophy

creature:Greydwarf_Elite.text: drops Greydwarf Eye, Stone, Wood, Dandelion, Ancient Seed, Greydwarf Brute Trophy

creature:Greydwarf.text: drops Greydwarf Eye, Stone, Wood, Resin, Greydwarf Trophy

creature:Greydwarf_Shaman.text: drops Greydwarf Eye, Wood, Resin, Greydwarf Shaman Trophy, Bukeperries

boss:gd_king.text: summon with 3 Ancient Seed · drops The Elder Trophy, Swamp Key

where:CarrotSeeds.text: Found on the ground in the Black Forest (guides). Plant it on cultivated ground to grow Carrots.

where:ElderBark.text: Chop Ancient Trees in the Swamp with a Bronze Axe or better; Sunken Crypt chests can hold some too (guides).

where:FineWood.text: Drops from birch and oak logs; guides say a Bronze Axe or better is needed. Also in some world structures.

where:Feathers.text: Shoot birds. Guides list crows and seagulls; the game files list Hen, Chicken and Volture as drops. Also found in chests.

where:FirCone.text: Drops when you chop fir trees

where:PineCone.text: Drops when you chop pine trees, not every time.

where:RoundLog.text: Chop pine trees; some world furniture also drops it.

where:AxeHead1.text: Found in chests in the Meadows (confirmed by the owner's son, who found and crafted it; the game files do not list the loot)

where:TinOre.text: Mine tin deposits in shallow water
